name: Tyler Arboretum Summer Camp
description_short: Nature day camp across Tyler Arboretum's 650 acres of creeks, meadows, trails and gardens for rising kindergarten to 5th graders, in three age groups. Campers spend the day outside, hiking up to two miles, playing in creeks, cooking from the garden and making nature crafts, with an air conditioned home base for bad weather.
refund_policy_summary: Written cancellation by May 1 gets a full refund less a 10% fee; from May 2 to 15 days before the camp week, a 50% refund; within 14 days, a 15% refund; none from the first day of the week or for absences. Transfers to another week are possible, subject to space.
notes: Camp day 9:00 to 4:00, before care 8:00 to 9:00, after care 4:00 to 5:00. Families choose from tiered rates (amounts not posted on the page); Family level members and above get 10% off. The page says registration for summer 2027 opens in January; no 2027 dates or rates are posted yet.
